description: Crawls a site politely (robots.txt honoured, one request at a time) from the start URL, its sitemap and any pinned pages, then runs the cross-page checks: duplicate titles and content, broken links, links to redirects, orphan and deep pages, sitemap errors, soft 404s and hreflang return links. Use it for a whole-site health check; use audit_page for one page. It can take several minutes. Returns startUrl; stop (complete, limit, stopped or error); pages, each with url, status, title, wordCount and its findings; findings, one site-wide roll-up per cross-page check saying how many pages it fired on; and notes on what was left out. Each finding has checkId (a WorkPods check id), layer (seo, geo, axo), group, status (pass, partial, fail or not_applicable), severity (critical, high, medium or low on a fail or partial, null otherwise), a one-sentence summary and evidence (selector, url, value, note).

limit.description: The most pages to fetch, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 200.

pinned.description: Money pages to crawl first, whatever the limit: pricing, product, booking or contact pages, as absolute URLs. Defaults to none.

url.description: Where the crawl starts, usually the home page, an absolute http or https URL such as https://example.com/.

name: crawl_site
title: Crawl a site
